data.job: Turn these app reviews into a ranked bug backlog

params.condition: Is this text written by a user about the app?
params.true_means: Any user feedback about the app: complaints, bug reports, praise, feature requests, questions, and comments about the articles, writers or other content in the app
params.false_means: Spam, advertisements, promotions, or text unrelated to the app

nodes.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.

params.instructions: Which category best describes the text?

options.bug: Reports something broken, crashing, failing, slow, or not working as expected
options.feature_request: Asks for new functionality or an option the app does not have yet
options.praise: Positive feedback with no complaint and no request
options.billing: About charges, payments, refunds, or subscriptions

nodes.why: Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.

params.focus: the specific problem or request in the feedback

nodes.why: Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.
Merge bug reports that describe the same problem.

dimensions.name: severity
dimensions.instructions: How severe is the problem described in the text for the user?
levels: A feature is broken or unusable
The app crashes, loses data, or charges money wrongly

nodes.why: Rate how severe each bug is for the user.

params.criterion: urgency of fixing this issue for users

nodes.why: Order the bugs by urgency, one entry per duplicate group, to make the backlog.
Count items per type and theme and average the bug urgency for the report.

data.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.
Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.
Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.

value.name: Login failures
value.description: Users report being unable to sign in or log in to the app, often after updates or with various methods; not account creation issues.

value.name: Sign-up problems
value.description: Users report being unable to create a new account or complete the sign-up process; not login issues for existing accounts.

value.name: Email verification loops
value.description: Users get stuck in a loop where email verification links don't work or keep sending them back to sign-up; not general login failures.

value.name: App crashes
value.description: The app crashes, freezes, or becomes unresponsive during use; not slow performance or loading issues.

value.name: Slow performance
value.description: The app is slow, laggy, or takes a long time to load or respond; not crashes or freezes.

value.name: Offline reading missing
value.description: Users want the ability to save articles for offline reading or find that offline mode doesn't work; not general reading issues.

value.name: Writing feature removed
value.description: Users complain that the ability to write or edit articles on the mobile app has been removed; not issues with reading or other features.

value.name: Draft management issues
value.description: Problems with accessing, saving, or editing drafts in the app; not issues with publishing or writing new articles.

value.name: Paywall and free limits
value.description: Users are frustrated by paywalls, premium articles, or daily/monthly reading limits in the free version; not general content quality issues.

value.name: Dark mode problems
value.description: Issues with dark mode, such as unreadable text, missing titles, or poor display; not general display or font size issues.

value.name: Font size and display
value.description: Users want to adjust font size or complain about text appearance, blurriness, or lack of display settings; not dark mode issues.

value.name: Scrolling issues
value.description: Problems with scrolling, such as lag, jumping, or inability to scroll smoothly; not general performance or loading issues.

value.name: Link Handling
value.description: Complaints about links opening in an internal browser or not opening in a native app; not general app crashes.

value.name: Screen Rotation
value.description: Requests for screen rotation support or auto-rotate on tablets and e-readers; not display font size issues.

value.name: Content Organization
value.description: Requests for sorting, favorites, history, or easy access to saved articles; not draft management.

notes: refinement: ran on 109 outliers; 3 new themes (Link Handling, Screen Rotation, Content Organization)

notes: 63 items in none_of_these were not deduped
kept each item's 5 most similar candidates: 191 of 208 similar pairs
70 matched pairs not merged (no direct match with the cluster's canonical)

Order the bugs by urgency, one entry per duplicate group, to make the backlog.
Count items per type and theme and average the bug urgency for the report.

data.value: We turned 1000 app reviews into a ranked bug backlog, keeping 956 items and dropping 44. The kept items included 405 praise, 185 bug, 174 other, 124 billing and 68 feature_request, and the largest theme groups were Login failures at 22, Paywall and free limits at 21, Writing feature removed at 19, Slow performance at 15 and App crashes at 14. Urgency was scored for 185 items with a mean of 63.0 and a median of 66.7. Jev made 2309 of the 2926 decisions, the LLM made 612, and code made 5, with 1 low-confidence case. The run took 120.5 seconds and cost 0.0964 USD in total.
